entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: An elder dragon, archmage and planeswalker who rules Amonkhet as the God-Pharaoh and defeats the Gatewatch single-handedly before stepping into the open.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A telepath and illusionist of the Gatewatch whose mind is nearly destroyed by Bolas, so that he planeswalks away blindly.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A necromancer and planeswalker of the Gatewatch who, offered a way out by Bolas, abandons the group.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A pyromancer and planeswalker of the Gatewatch who fights Bolas with fire and flees badly injured.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: An elementalist planeswalker of the Gatewatch whom Bolas strangles with necrotic tendrils and corrupts through the land.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: An invulnerable soldier planeswalker of the Gatewatch who is batted about and pierced by Bolas and flees across the Blind Eternities.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: A planeswalker who serves Bolas and arrives late to the plaza to be sent to fetch Ral Zarek.

entities.name: Ral Zarek
entities.description: A planeswalker whose progress Bolas finds too slow and whom Tezzeret is sent to summon.

entities.name: The Raven Man
entities.description: A voice in Liliana's mind that urges her to listen to Bolas and to leave.

entities.name: The Gatewatch
entities.description: The group of five planeswalkers that confront Nicol Bolas and are defeated.

entities.name: Onakke
entities.description: The ancient dead whose spirits dwell in the Chain Veil.

entities.name: Chain Veil
entities.description: A relic carrying the spirits of the Onakke dead that Liliana uses at risk of death or subjugation and that Bolas claims he can unlock.

entities.name: Kefnet
entities.description: A dead god of Amonkhet.

entities.name: Erebos
entities.description: The god of death who killed all Gideon held dear.

entities.name: Razaketh
entities.description: A demon whom Liliana defeated.

entities.name: Drasus
entities.description: A lost companion of Gideon's Irregulars who appears in his guilt-ridden visions.

entities.name: Olexo
entities.description: A lost member of Gideon's Irregulars.

entities.name: Gideon's Irregulars
entities.description: Gideon's band of lost companions on Zendikar.

entities.name: The Blind Eternities
entities.description: The space between planes through which the defeated planeswalkers flee.

entities.name: Amonkhet
entities.description: The plane Bolas prepared for sixty years, now in ruins.

entities.name: Ruined Plaza
entities.description: A plaza strewn with rubble and bodies where the Gatewatch faces Bolas.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: A plane where Liliana compared her feelings for Jace to those toward a pet.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: The plane where Gideon watched people die.

events.summary: Bolas flies toward the five waiting planeswalkers and reflects on his decades of preparation on Amonkhet.
events.quote: At the edges of the plaza, five planeswalkers stood arrayed against him

events.summary: Bolas lands and roars, judging the Gatewatch's simple kill-the-dragon plan.
events.quote: They had chosen kill the dragon .

events.summary: Gideon, in rage, demands they fight Bolas at once, and the Gatewatch attack with everything they have.
events.quote: They began. Gideon charged, his golden force shield shimmering

events.summary: Bolas swats Gideon against a wall with his tail while ignoring the other attacks.
events.quote: Gideon sailed into a thick brick wall lining one side of the plaza.

events.summary: Jace attacks Bolas's mind but is lured into a trap and the dragon squeezes his mind.
events.quote: The obsidian shield disappeared, and Jace fell unexpectedly into Nicol Bolas's mind.

events.summary: Facing mind-death, Jace blindly planeswalks away across the Blind Eternities.
events.quote: Without conscious thought, he began planeswalking away blindly, not knowing or caring where.

events.summary: Liliana, shaken by Jace's scream, is torn between the Chain Veil's urging and the Raven Man's counsel as Bolas taunts her.
events.quote: Yes, use us. Unleash your full power

events.summary: Bolas offers to teach Liliana to master the Chain Veil and tells her to go if she wants to live.
events.quote: I can help you unlock its power, Liliana.

events.summary: Liliana urges the others to retreat, then asks Bolas where he wants her to go, and flees, betraying Chandra's trust.
events.quote: Where . . . where do you want me to go?

events.summary: Liliana vanishes into the void as Chandra screams at her betrayal.
events.quote: She surrounded herself in a glowing nimbus of dark energy and vanished into the void

events.summary: Chandra drives Bolas back with white fire for the first time, but he dismisses her as a child.
events.quote: he was forced backward for the first time in the fight

events.summary: Nissa raises spurs and a giant earth elemental against Bolas, but he crushes Chandra in his claw and shatters her defenses.
events.quote: He swooped in and grabbed her in a huge claw.

events.summary: Bolas strangles Nissa with necrotic tendrils, and she tells Chandra to flee; Chandra planeswalks away injured.
events.quote: She planeswalked away in a fiery blaze

events.summary: Bolas corrupts the leylines Nissa controls, and Gideon's interruption lets her flee the plane.
events.quote: She used Gideon's interruption to flee from this dead husk of a world.

events.summary: Bolas grabs Gideon and pierces his shield and shoulder with a talon, then offers him the choice to stay and die or leave and live.
events.quote: the shield parted like melted butter

events.summary: Haunted by memories of lost friends, Gideon chooses to leave and live and planeswalks away.
events.quote: He willed his body through the Blind Eternities

events.summary: Tezzeret arrives late, and Bolas sends him to fetch Ral Zarek, saying the battle was better than blood.
events.quote: Go and tell Ral Zarek to come to me.

events.summary: Bolas roars, declaring the planar bridge his and the army ready, and steps openly out of the shadows.
events.quote: was finally taking his first steps, visibly and openly.

relations.quote: No, master, I did not doubt.
The Gatewatch was loose in the Multiverse.

relations.note: follows his instruction to leave and be found by him
relations.quote: I will find you, and then we will talk.
We trusted you! I trusted you!

relations.note: holds the spirits of the Onakke dead
relations.quote: the Chain Veil, and with it the spirits of the Onakke dead.
when Erebos had killed all he held dear.
